question: Which group of Narasimha forms is to be worshipped in the third eight-petaled layer?
premises: A third eight-petaled layer is specified.
A group of eight is to be worshipped there.
The group consists of forms of Narasimha.
inference: In the third eight-petaled layer, a group of eight Narasimhas should be worshipped.
plain_english: In the third eight-petaled layer, a group of eight Narasimhas is likewise to be worshipped.
